Each mystery: 1) read the stopped clock (twenty past three), 2) ask questions (Where were you at…? What did you do at…?), 3) set the time machine and check yesterday (irregular verbs: ate, swam, broke…; There was nobody here), 4) say who took the cup. Level 1: o'clock and half past, two suspects. Level 2: quarters and minutes, three suspects.
